With Jordan’s World Cup players on the roster, Al Hussein had created chance after chance and hit the framework four times. On other occasions, Phurba Lachenpa kept East Bengal in the game they had to win to stay alive in Asian Champions League 2.

stories.title: 'Never Expected Him To Attack Me Personally': Usman Khawaja Makes Emotional Admission After Pat Cummins' Explosive Sandpapergate Press Conference
stories.summary: Former Australia opener Usman Khawaja has revealed that he was left deeply hurt by Pat Cummins' explosive press conference addressing the infamous 2018 Sandpapergate scandal. Khawaja admitted that he never expected the Australian captain to personally attack him while responding to allegations made in his recently released autobiography, Sabr.

stories.title: Sooryavanshi, 15, breaks sixes record in 204 off 53 balls
stories.summary: India's 15-year-old batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the most sixes ever recorded in a senior men's innings in blazing 204 from 53 balls for India A against the United Arab Emirates. While almost halving the record for the fastest double-century in List A cricket, Sooryavanshi hit 28 sixes and seven fours in the Asia Cup Rising Stars competition - easily breaking Chad Bowes' previous record of 103 balls from 2024 .

stories.title: Leaked FIFA documents show Infantino’s 96-year private equity plan for World Cup
stories.summary: The leaked documents, including a FIFA in-house risk assessment, show its own finance officials “were not directly privy to the construction of this transaction”

stories.title: Yuvraj Singh’s role behind Vaibhav Sooryavanshi blitz: How a 30-minute conversation helped shape his double ton
stories.summary: When you look at Vaibhav Sooryavanshi , a lack of confidence is not something you associate with him. On the contrary, one might feel that he is a bit overambitious on occasion.

stories.title: Punjab Kings appoint Paras Mhambrey as fast bowling coach
stories.summary: Punjab Kings have appointed Paras Mhambrey as their fast bowling coach ahead of the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL). The former India pacer was previously with Mumbai Indians. The 54-year-old, who played 91 first-class games for Mumbai between 1992 and 2003 besides five international games for India, comes to the Punjab-based franchise with loads of coaching experience.

stories.title: Champions League: Bellingham wondergoal helps Real Madrid thump PSV; Arsenal and Man City held
stories.summary: Jude Bellingham came off the bench to score a spectacular goal as ​Real Madrid maintained their perfect Champions League start with a 5-1 comeback victory over PSV Eindhoven on Tuesday (November 24, 2026), while ‌Arsenal were held 1-1 at home by Borussia Dortmund and Manchester City drew ​2-2 with Napoli.

stories.title: Bellingham plays down Zidane comparison after wonder goal
stories.summary: Spanish football reporter at Bernabeu Published 10 minutes ago Manager Jose Mourinho described Jude Bellingham as "without any doubt, the best midfielder in the world" following a wonder goal which inspired a brilliant second-half performance for Real Madrid in a 5-1 win against PSV .

stories.title: Why Ben Stokes could become the costliest player at the IPL auction
stories.summary: Former England captain Ben Stokes could emerge as the costliest buy at the upcoming IPL mini-auction, scheduled to be held in Goa on December 16. Stokes, who has represented three IPL franchises in the past, is expected to trigger a bidding war between Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) and Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR).

stories.title: Asia Cup heroes Aaryavir Sehwag and Mohit Ulva in IPL auction register; Ben Stokes, Sonny Baker in too
stories.summary: Aaryavir Sehwag, son of legendary Indian opener Virender Sehwag , has registered for the upcoming IPL 2027 auction. Aaryavir, who was instrumental in India’s title-winning campaign during the recently concluded Under-19 Asia Cup, has set his base price at ₹ 30 lakh. India’s hero in the tournament final against Pakistan, Mohit Ulva, has also registered for the auction at the same base price.

stories.title: Three Fort Hood shooting survivors lose final appeal to witness Nidal Hasan’s execution
stories.summary: Three survivors of the shooting at Fort Hood will not be allowed to witness the execution of Nidal Hasan, who fatally shot 13 people in the attack at the Texas Army post in 2009, military officials said on Tuesday (November 24, 2026). Hasan was found guilty of multiple counts of murder and attempted murder related to those killed and the more than 30 who were wounded by gunfire in the attack.

stories.title: Northants begin T20 Blast defence at Hampshire
stories.summary: Northamptonshire Steelbacks will begin the defence of their T20 Blast crown with a repeat of last season's final, travelling to Hampshire Hawks on Friday, 21 May. It is one of nine back-to-back men's and women's matches happening across the opening weekend of the 2027 campaign as the competition celebrates its 25th edition.

stories.title: Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom
stories.summary: Donald Trump awarded Rudy Giuliani, his former personal attorney who was disbarred for his efforts to help the US president overturn 2020 election results , with the presidential medal of freedom on Tuesday. “I am honored and humbled to receive the Presidential Medal of Freedom from my nation and from President Donald J Trump,” Giuliani, 82, wrote in an X post hours after the award had been presented to him.

stories.title: Bumrah closes in on Starc for No.1 spot as Jaiswal joins Pant, Gill in Test top 10
stories.summary: India pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah is closing in on Australia's Mitchell Starc at the top of the ICC Test bowling rankings, having climbed three places to share second position in the latest update. Bumrah's five-wicket match haul in the first Test against New Zealand, which ended in a draw, earned him a significant jump in the latest standings.

stories.title: Ice hockey federation appeals against Russia ban ruling
stories.summary: The International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF) will appeal against a Court of Arbitration for Sport (Cas) ruling to reinstate Russia in next year's World Championship. Russia has been banned from competing in IIHF events since the invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, with the sport's global governing body ruling earlier this year that the exclusion would continue.

stories.title: Russia accuses NATO member Estonia of hostile actions ‘on the verge of unleashing open war’
stories.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry has lashed out at Estonia's government, accusing the NATO member of carrying out a range of "hostile actions" and putting the Baltic state "on the verge of unleashing open war" with Moscow. The outburst underscores rising tensions between Russia and countries on NATO's eastern flank and comes after Estonia announced it will close its road border crossings with Russia from Dec.

stories.title: AFC Champions League Two: East Bengal takes on Al-Hussein in a must-win tie
stories.summary: East Bengal FC faces a decisive test in its continental campaign as it hosts Jordan’s Al-Hussein SC at the Salt Lake Stadium in a Group D clash of the AFC Champions League Two on Tuesday. With qualification for the round of 16 hanging in the balance, the red and gold brigade approaches the penultimate round of the group stage knowing that a victory is essential to keep its hopes alive.

stories.title: Aneurin Donald slams explosive 85 as England thrash Australia in 2nd T20I
stories.summary: Aneurin Donald smacked a blistering 85 and Phil Salt 58 in a batting masterclass as England crushed Australia by eight wickets in the second T20 international on Tuesday to level the series 1-1. Aneurin hit nine sixes and four boundaries in his stunning knock off just 32 balls.

stories.title: U14 Giles Shield Cricket Tournament : Tanish Kadam's 170, Ranveer Singh's 169 Headline Massive Wins For Cardinal Gracis & Sri Maa Vidyalaya
stories.summary: Tanish struck an unbeaten 170 to power Cardinal Gracis High School to a comprehensive 221-run victory over Oberoi International School at the MB Union Ground, Cross Maidan. Cardinal Gracis posted 303-4 before Ayaan Shaikh (3/10) and Saksham Sharma (3/9) helped dismiss the opposition for 82. Ranveer Singh hammered an unbeaten 169 as Sri Maa Vidyalaya registered a massive 506-run victory over Bhakti Vedanta Swami Mission School.

stories.title: 'Random' move has Murrell flourishing at Falkirk
stories.summary: "It was completely random," is how Jacob Murrell describes his summer switch from DC United to Falkirk. Now the 22 year-old American is the joint-leading scorer in the Scottish Premiership, with eight goals from 11 starts. His tremendous form has helped Falkirk surge up the table, with six successive victories taking them from 11th to third place.

stories.title: The Full Beaver Supermoon arrived today. Know what it means according to a spiritual expert
stories.summary: November Full Moon 2026: Let' read the spiritual significance of the Supermoon arrived tonight according to a spiritual expert. The Beaver Supermoon, or the Full Moon in Gemini on November 24, 2026, offered an opportunity to reflect on your thoughts, communication and personal growth.

stories.title: What are the disputes between Iraq's federal government and Kurdistan region?
stories.summary: The orders are part of a broader crackdown by Zaidi against oil smuggling. They also reopen long-running disputes between Baghdad and the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) over control of oil, money, territory and trade. Though Baghdad says state oil marketer SOMO has sole authority to export Iraq’s crude, for years the KRG exported independently through a pipeline to Turkey’s Ceyhan port.

stories.title: Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 22, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), the country’s apex food-safety regulator, sanctioned prosecution against packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International Pvt. Ltd. after a sample of its water was found to be non-compliant with prescribed safety standards, with the regulator declaring it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

stories.title: Why India is betting Rs 11,000 crore on construction, infrastructure equipment manufacturing - explained
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved an Rs 11,000-crore scheme to strengthen India's construction and infrastructure equipment (CIE) manufacturing ecosystem, with a focus on increasing domestic production, supporting component makers and setting up a dedicated testing facility.The decisions were announced by Union minister Ashwini Vaishnaw at a press briefing following the Cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.The Scheme for Enhancement of Construction and Infrastructure Equipment Manufacturing Ecosystem will be implemented by the Ministry of…

stories.title: What does ₹1.25L monthly budget look like? ‘ ₹30,000 grocery, ₹20,000 grooming’: Noida couple’s expenses go viral
stories.summary: Owning a home does not always mean that monthly expenses are low. 25 lakh every month, even though they own their house and do not have to pay rent. The couple shared a video on Instagram explaining their monthly expenses. Their spending includes groceries, household help, gym memberships , grooming, food and travel.

stories.title: The price of no climate deal: After COP31, what's next for India and the world | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations (UN) climate summit in Antalya, COP31, ran two days over schedule and ended on November 22 without a cover decision, the overarching text that sums up what a summit achieved. As petrostates like Saudi Arabia and Russia pushed to omit fossil fuels from the final draft, the text was reluctantly accepted by many countries.

stories.title: ​The Tata family tree explained​
stories.summary: A family divided over the future of the Tata empire. Jimmy Tata has accused his half-brother Noel Tata of trying to consolidate family control over Tata Trusts and Tata Sons. As the dispute over governance and control intensifies, we trace the family ties connecting Jamsetji, Ratan, Jimmy and Noel Tata.

stories.title: Why has the INDIA bloc posed 48 questions to the Election Commission over SIR?
stories.summary: The Supreme Court’s decision to hear an application by Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi and other Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) bloc leaders seeking leave to deliver 48 interrogatories to the Election Commission of India (ECI) has added a new dimension to the legal challenge against the nationwide Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

stories.title: Who is Hima Ninama? Teenage aspiring athlete from MP earns David Beckham's praise after stopping her child marriage
stories.summary: A 17-year-old girl from Madhya Pradesh has drawn international attention after refusing to let her family's marriage plans interrupt her education, with former England football captain David Beckham sharing her story on social media to mark World Children's Day. Hima Ninama, a resident of Barkheda village in Jhabua district, stood up against her proposed child marriage while studying in Class 11.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why we feel sleepier in a moving car even when we are well-rested
stories.summary: From engine vibrations to monotonous motion, here are the reasons why car rides often make us feel sleepy. Do you also feel sleepy while travelling in a car? You are not the only one to feel that. Feeling sleepy in a moving vehicle is a combination of several factors.

stories.title: Inside COP31’s last 50 hours: A day of waiting, a 3am text, and ‘Simon, take your seat’ | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The United Nations climate conference (COP31) in Türkiye's Antalya was supposed to conclude on Friday, November 20, and bring about a negotiated outcome document. It did neither. Delegates spent two more days waiting for texts that came late or not at all, often with little idea of who was negotiating what.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: Why Should Airlines Exploit Desperate Families?: Jharkhand Health Minister Irfan Ansari Writes To PM Modi,
stories.summary: ': Jharkhand Health Minister Irfan Ansari Writes To PM Modi, Demands Cap On Rising Airfares | Ranchi: Jharkhand Health Minister Irfan Ansari wrote to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, alleging a steep rise in airfares and urging the Centre to cap ticket prices and curb "arbitrary" fare hikes by airlines.

stories.title: With AI, scientists may solve their hardest problems faster than they can understand why | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Two prestigious unsolved problems in mathematics may have been solved with the help of AI in the past week, although the author of one of the proofs said he cannot yet fully explain it. Every school student learns that an answer without the working earns few marks, since the working is how a teacher follows the reasoning.

stories.title: Explainer-Mexico nabs yet another top drug lord, but history of ‘Kingpin Strategy’ mixed
stories.summary: Chapo Isidro was considered one of the leaders of the Beltrán Leyva Organization, a former ally of the powerful Sinaloa Cartel that later became one of its top rivals. His capture is the latest in a string of arrests of high-profile suspected drug traffickers as Mexico — under intense pressure from US President Donald Trump — has decisively returned to the so-called Kingpin Strategy.

stories.title: Inside Trump's Secret Mission to Bring Jensen Huang Back To Nvidia | Explained
stories.summary: S. President Donald Trump personally intervened to orchestrate Jensen Huang’s stunning return as chief executive of Nvidia—just 11 days after the tech boss resigned amid an intelligence scandal—according to a CNN report detailing a weekend-long White House pressure campaign. S. economy, and America’s lead in the global AI race, Trump contacted Nvidia’s board directly—even dialing into a board meeting—while assigning Vice President JD Vance to coordinate an intensive 72-hour push with directors.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Civilian defence staff seek 6% annual increment, OPS and 50% DA merger— 13 key demands explained
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Pratiraksha Mazdoor Sangh (BPMS), an all-India federation of civilian defence employees recognised by the Ministry of Defence, has submitted a fresh list of around 73 demands to the 8th Central Pay Commission (CPC), seeking substantial improvements in salaries, pensions and service benefits for central government employees, particularly defence civilian personnel.

stories.title: What do lemurs and opera singers share?
stories.summary: Have you seen opera performers sing? You might notice how their mouths move according to how high their pitch needs to be. Imagine finding out a primate in the rainforests of Madagascar has been doing the same, possibly even before opera began? With a pointy snout, large eyes and usually a long tail, you might have encountered this primate in one of your favourite movies, Madagascar.

stories.title: Year-round tax planning for salaried employees: a 12-month approach explained
stories.summary: By Archit GuptaEvery person’s personal finance rests on three things. The first is protecting yourself and your family through life and health insurance. The second is your home, and the loan that usually comes with it. The third is building wealth, turning your savings into a corpus that grows over time, whether that corpus is a retirement fund decades away or simply money set aside for a year-end holiday.

stories.title: Cases against Megaspeed, the Singapore firm tied to Jensen Huang’s brief ouster from Nvidia | HT Explainers
stories.summary: The US on Monday blacklisted Megaspeed International, the Singapore company whose former chief executive's affair with Jensen Huang led to his brief ouster from Nvidia , as an investigation continues into whether it moved the American firm's AI chips into China. Nvidia reinstated Huang the same day the US announced its decision.

stories.title: What lies beyond Wayanad’s misty mountains?
stories.summary: The path narrows between rows of dark-green coffee bushes. The low branches of pepper sag under tight clusters of unripe green cherries. Spiders hang their webs between the plants and along the poles. ,” says one visitor, ducking the hanging web, afraid to break it. Arun George, the owner of GP Ecotic Land, Coffee and Eco Tourism, in Kattikulam, Wayanad explains how a chemical spray would have cleared them away.

stories.title: Who is Sugandha Hiremath? Meet businesswoman at centre of Kalyani family’s ₹1 lakh crore ancestral wealth dispute
stories.summary: Sugandha Hiremath, sister of Bharat Forge chairman Baba Kalyani, is at the centre of a high-profile inheritance dispute involving the Kalyani family’s ancestral wealth , estimated at more than ₹ 1 lakh crore. The legal battle, which has dragged on across judicial forums, involves claims over family assets, properties and stakes in companies linked to the Pune-based industrial family.

stories.title: Can you play as Jason and Lucia together in GTA 6? Character-switching explained
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 gives players two protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, who share a story and work together as partners. But can players actually take control of both characters at the same time? The answer is yes and no. GTA 6 allows players to bring Jason and Lucia together for activities, missions and robberies, but they cannot directly control both characters simultaneously.

stories.title: Aboard the newly-launched Cordelia Sky’s Mumbai weekend cruise
stories.summary: Cordelia Sky is enormous. I get an idea of its magnitude from the embarkation lounge. As I board my first cruiseliner, flashes from movies come to me, from the holiday reverie of Dil Dhadakne Do to the Edwardian excesses of Titanic. As I step into the ship’s circular atrium, I am greeted by smiling crew and offered a refreshing welcome drink.

stories.title: Charlie Puth, Ellie Goulding to perform at inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai; check details
stories.summary: Business Today Desk Updated Nov 24, 2026 6:15 PM IST Charlie Puth, known for global hits including Attention, We Don't Talk Anymore and See You Again, expressed excitement about performing for Indian audiences. Grammy-nominated singer, songwriter and producer Charlie Puth will perform in India for the first time on February 13, 2027, headlining the inaugural Johnnie & Co.

stories.title: Explore the regional flavours of Uttarakhand in Mumbai at 8ish through this unique food pop-up
stories.summary: In Uttarakhand’s hills, some of the most interesting ingredients aren’t necessarily found in markets or on restaurant menus. They grow wild along forest paths, in fields and in people’s backyards. It takes some curiosity, and a willingness to look beyond the familiar, to source them.

stories.title: Mumbai Book Festival 2026: A complete guide to unique events this week
stories.summary: Bibliophiles in the suburbs have much to cheer at the inaugural edition of the Mumbai Book Festival 2026. It’s being organised by National Book Trust, Ministry of Education, Government of Maharashtra, BMC, and University of Mumbai and runs from today till November 29 at the sprawling Kalina campus of the University of Mumbai.

stories.title: Mumbai: Boy travels to Delhi after leaving madrassa, reunited with family after two months
stories.summary: Unwilling to return to his madrassa and fearing that his parents would force him to resume his studies, a 10-year-old boy from Powai travelled to Delhi, hoping to remain unrecognised in the national capital. After spending nearly two months away from home , the boy was eventually traced in Delhi’s RK Puram area after a group of children spotted him roaming around a garden and trying to play with them.

stories.title: Immerse in the inaugural edition of this book festival for little children in Mumbai
stories.summary: We at Peek-A-Book have always believed that it’s never too early to start reading. But there’s never been a festival for readers who are as young as one-year-olds,” says Lubaina Bandukwala, founder of the Peek-A-Book Festival for young readers.

stories.title: YouTuber's Chhath remarks on married women's sindoor spark outrage, FIR filed
stories.summary: Patna Cyber Police registered an FIR against YouTuber Yash Maheshwari for making derogatory remarks about women. The comments were made during a stand-up performance, which caused significant public outrage. Following the controversy, Maheshwari issued a public apology acknowledging the inappropriateness of his remarks. The Bihar State Women's Commission has also demanded strict action and removal of the video.

stories.title: Srinagar's Ancient Durgeshwari Temple Reopens After 37 Years; Here's Why It Deserves A Spot On Your Travel Itinerary
stories.summary: Srinagar, known for its picturesque Dal Lake, snow-capped mountains and beautiful gardens, is also home to several ancient temples that reflect Kashmir's rich cultural and spiritual heritage. One such historic landmark, the Durgeshwari Temple, reopened on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, after remaining closed for nearly 37 years. The temple was closed due to militancy and the Kashmiri exodus.
